## Currently shipping at 10x Productivity

- Owns ~90% of the backend — full pipeline from data ingestion through AI analysis, intelligence aggregation, AI agents, storyboard generation, asset production, and PDF report delivery
- Asset-level AI analysis pipeline using Gemini and Claude across 90+ structured-output LLM call sites; scene-by-scene video breakdowns, 5 dimensions × 80+ sub-dimensions per creative

- Storyboard + creative production pipeline (Imagen reference grids, Fal AI / Veo 3.1, OpenAI, Bria) — 20 production-grade images/week, 50 videos/month
- 13+ production PDF report types via Handlebars templates and Puppeteer two-pass rendering
- BullMQ scheduled crons with Redis leader election for Facebook Marketing API, Facebook Ads Library, and AppMagic ingestion
- Authored backend coding standards, testing rulebook, and shared test infrastructure adopted across every NestJS library in the monorepo
